title: Update sage in Claude Code and in Codex: about 5 minutes

blocks.label: When
blocks.text: After the three pull requests for the new words merge. I tell you when the last one merges.

blocks.label: Why
blocks.text: Your sessions run the sage that you installed. The new words reach the board and the chat only after the update.
**Warning:** start new sessions after the update. A session that is already open keeps its old instructions.

items.text: In a terminal, update sage for Claude Code:
items.see: Then start a new Claude Code session.

items.text: In a terminal, update sage for Codex:
items.see: Then start a new Codex session.

items.text: If Codex shows “Hooks need review”, choose “Trust all and continue”. If it warns that sage hooks are changed or not trusted, run the command that the warning names, then type /hooks and trust the 7 sage hooks.
items.see: If you see no sage line at all after the update, type /hooks anyway: when no sage hook is trusted, none runs, so none can warn you.

items.text: Ask for the board. If its line says that a restart is needed, run the stop command that it gives, then ask for the board again.

blocks.label: How you know it worked
blocks.text: The board names “Milestone 5: Sage feel”, and each task has a state word such as “in progress”.

blocks.label: Your time
blocks.text: About 5 minutes of human time (estimate, 3 to 10: four commands and two new sessions).

blocks.label: If a step fails
blocks.text: Tell me the step and what you see.
